title: Sustainable production practices
log: 2026-11-20T12:15:15Z match: Claude Haiku 5.5 found no bank point the same, so it is written new

match.reason: The bank point teaches the general meaning of sustainability with fishing and forest examples, while the new point teaches specific sustainable production practices such as renewable energy, recycling, reduced packaging and fair trade, so it is a related but different idea.

draft.title: Sustainable production practices
card: Sustainable production means making goods in ways that limit harm to the environment and to people. It aims to protect resources so they last for the future.
power from sources that are not used up, such as sun and wind. A factory using solar panels burns less coal or gas.
turning used materials, such as scrap metal or old plastic, into new products. This means fewer new raw materials need to be taken from the land.
workers are paid fairly and work in safe conditions. Reducing packaging is another practice, because it uses fewer materials and creates less waste.
draft.remember: Sustainable production limits harm to the environment and to workers, for example through renewable energy, recycling, less packaging and fair pay.

a.q: A shoe company in Vietnam makes new shoes from old plastic bottles. Which sustainable practice is this?
a.why: Old plastic is turned into new products, so this is recycling materials. It is not renewable energy, because no power source is involved. It is not reducing packaging, because the bottles are the shoe's raw material, not its wrapping.
a.clue: Think about what happens to the used bottles.

b.q: Ayesha runs a chocolate company in Ghana. She buys cocoa from farmers at a price that covers their costs and allows a decent living. Which practice does this show?
b.why: Paying farmers a fair price for their work is fair trade. It is tempting to say recycling materials because it sounds like a good environmental practice, but nothing is being reused here. The focus is on people being paid fairly.
b.clue: Look at who is being paid, and how.
